title: Discussing Military Tactics on Paper
synopsis: The idiom "discussing military tactics on paper" refers to theoretical discussions or plans that lack practical experience or real-world applicability. It originates from the story of Zhao Kuo, a general during the Warring States period, who relied solely on his book knowledge of warfare and ended up leading his army to a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Changping.

fullText.simplified:
纸上谈兵

    战国年代，中国分为七国，七国之间常年战争不断。公元前260年，七国中的秦国和赵国正在交战。第一战打完，赵国失利。赵国老将军廉颇决定不再进攻，他带着军队守在山上，等待好的时机再进行第二战。
    虽然赵国国王想早点结束战争，但他还是支持廉颇的做法，因为他知道廉颇是一个很有经验的老将军。但是好几个月过去后，赵国国内出现了这样的说法：廉颇就是老了，害怕了，所以不敢打；年轻的赵括将军很有能力，更适合带军，应该把机会让给年轻人。赵括是谁呢？他是赵国一名年轻的将领。在赵国人心中，赵括从小就读了很多兵书，也经常跟父亲讨论兵法，是个非常优秀的军事人才。只不过和别人的想法不一样，赵括的父亲从来不表扬赵括，也不同意赵括参与战争，他说赵括眼中的战争太简单了。
    赵国国王听多了别人的说法，慢慢心动了。过了一段时间，看到廉颇还是带着军队守在山上不动，赵国国王就让赵括代替廉颇当大将军，去领军攻打秦军。赵括非常激动，到了前线看了一下周围的环境，就带着军队向秦国军队发起了进攻。战争进行得很顺利，赵括用他从兵书上学到的兵法知识，把秦国军队打得不停后退。他兴奋极了，追着后退的秦军一路打下去，想把所有人都打败。直到半个月以后，赵括军队里的食物快吃完了，而从国内送食物来的队伍一直没有来，赵括这才发现由于他追秦军追得太远，把回国的战线拉得太长，送食物的道路已经被另一路秦军阻断了，现在他的军队不但马上就没有食物了，而且还不能回赵国去了。战况迅速改变，原来那些不停后退的秦国军队打了回来，把所有的赵国军队都围在了一起。这时的赵括知道他被秦军骗了，但已经太晚了。赵国军队被围了46天，最终包括赵括在内的所有人或被饿死或被杀死，45万人的大军无一生还。
    这就是长平之战中赵括纸上谈兵的故事。虽然赵括熟读兵书，但他只重视书本上的理论知识，忽视实战经验，因此不能真正解决战场上出现的实际问题，这才导致了赵国的大败。这次大败也让后人明白了实践的重要性。从此，纸上谈兵就变成了成语，用来形容只会嘴上说大道理，但不能实际解决问题的人。这个成语也在提醒人们要重视理论和实践的相结合。生活中，如果你遇到了像赵括这样的人，你可以这么说：“虽然他提了很多建议，但经常只是纸上谈兵，没有真正实践过。”你也可以这样说：“虽然他读了很多书，但是真正面对问题时，却发现自己只是纸上谈兵。”
fullText.traditional:
紙上談兵

    戰國年代，中國分為七國，七國之間常年戰爭不斷。公元前260年，七國中的秦國和趙國正在交戰。第一戰打完，趙國失利。趙國老將軍廉頗決定不再進攻，他帶著軍隊守在山上，等待好的時機再進行第二戰。
    雖然趙國國王想早點結束戰爭，但他還是支持廉頗的做法，因為他知道廉頗是一個很有經驗的老將軍。但是好幾個月過去後，趙國國內出現了這樣的說法：廉頗就是老了，害怕了，所以不敢打；年輕的趙括將軍很有能力，更適合帶軍，應該把機會讓給年輕人。趙括是誰呢？他是趙國一名年輕的將領。在趙國人心中，趙括從小就讀了很多兵書，也經常跟父親討論兵法，是個非常優秀的軍事人才。只不過和別人的想法不一樣，趙括的父親從來不表揚趙括，也不同意趙括參與戰爭，他說趙括眼中的戰爭太簡單了。
    趙國國王聽多了別人的說法，慢慢心動了。過了一段時間，看到廉頗還是帶著軍隊守在山上不動，趙國國王就讓趙括代替廉頗當大將軍，去領軍攻打秦軍。趙括非常激動，到了前線看了一下周圍的環境，就帶著軍隊向秦國軍隊發起了進攻。戰爭進行得很順利，趙括用他從兵書上學到的兵法知識，把秦國軍隊打得不停後退。他興奮極了，追著後退的秦軍一路打下去，想把所有人都打敗。直到半個月以後，趙括軍隊裡的食物快吃完了，而從國內送食物來的隊伍一直沒有來，趙括這才發現由於他追秦軍追得太遠，把回國的戰線拉得太長，送食物的道路已經被另一路秦軍阻斷了，現在他的軍隊不但馬上就沒有食物了，而且還不能回趙國去了。戰況迅速改變，原來那些不停後退的秦國軍隊打了回來，把所有的趙國軍隊都圍在了一起。這時的趙括知道他被秦軍騙了，但已經太晚了。趙國軍隊被圍了46天，最終包括趙括在內的所有人或被餓死或被殺死，45萬人的大軍無一生還。
    這就是長平之戰中趙括紙上談兵的故事。雖然趙括熟讀兵書，但他只重視書本上的理論知識，忽視實戰經驗，因此不能真正解決戰場上出現的實際問題，這才導致了趙國的大敗。這次大敗也讓後人明白了實踐的重要性。從此，紙上談兵就變成了成語，用來形容只會嘴上說大道理，但不能實際解決問題的人。這個成語也在提醒人們要重視理論和實踐的相結合。生活中，如果你遇到了像趙括這樣的人，你可以這麼說：“雖然他提了很多建議，但經常只是紙上談兵，沒有真正實踐過。”你也可以這樣說：“雖然他讀了很多書，但是真正面對問題時，卻發現自己只是紙上談兵。”

sentences.simplified: 45万人的大军无一生还。
sentences.traditional: 45萬人的大軍無一生還。
sentences.pinyin: 3 wàn rén de dà jūn wú yī shēng huán
sentences.english: The Zhao army was besieged for 46 days, and in the end, everyone, including Zhao Kuo, either starved to death or was killed.
Not a single one of the 450,000-strong army survived.

sentences.simplified: 这就是长平之战中赵括纸上谈兵的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這就是長平之戰中趙括紙上談兵的故事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì cháng píng zhī zhàn zhōng zhào kuò zhǐ shàng tán bīng de gù shi

sentences.simplified: 虽然赵括熟读兵书，
sentences.traditional: 雖然趙括熟讀兵書，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zhào kuò shú dú bīng shū
sentences.english: This is the story of Zhao Kuo’s “discussing military tactics on paper” in the Battle of Changping.

sentences.simplified: 但他只重视书本上的理论知识，忽视实战经验，
sentences.traditional: 但他只重視書本上的理論知識，忽視實戰經驗，
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā zhǐ zhòng shì shū běn shang de lǐ lùn zhī shi hū shì shí zhàn jīng yàn
sentences.english: Although Zhao Kuo was well-versed in military books, ..

sentences.simplified: 因此不能真正解决战场上出现的实际问题，这才导致了赵国的大败。
sentences.traditional: 因此不能真正解決戰場上出現的實際問題，這才導致了趙國的大敗。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ bù néng zhēn zhèng jiě jué zhàn chǎng shang chū xiàn de shí jì wèn tí zhè cái dǎo zhì le zhào guó de dà bài
sentences.english: .. he focused solely on theoretical knowledge from the books and neglected practical experience.

sentences.simplified: 这次大败也让后人明白了实践的重要性。
sentences.traditional: 這次大敗也讓後人明白了實踐的重要性。
sentences.pinyin: zhè cì dà bài yě ràng hòu rén míng bai le shí jiàn de zhòng yào xìng
sentences.english: As a result, he was unable to address the real issues that arose on the battlefield, leading to the great defeat of the Zhao state.

sentences.simplified: 从此，纸上谈兵就变成了成语，
sentences.traditional: 從此，紙上談兵就變成了成語，
sentences.pinyin: cóng cǐ zhǐ shàng tán bīng jiù biàn chéng le chéng yǔ
sentences.english: This great defeat also made future generations understand the importance of practical experience.

sentences.simplified: 用来形容只会嘴上说大道理，但不能实际解决问题的人。
sentences.traditional: 用來形容只會嘴上說大道理，但不能實際解決問題的人。
sentences.pinyin: yòng lái xíng róng zhǐ huì zuǐ shang shuō dà dào li dàn bù néng shí jì jiě jué wèn tí de rén
sentences.english: From then on, “discussing military tactics on paper” became an idiom ..

sentences.simplified: 这个成语也在提醒人们要重视理论和实践的相结合。
sentences.traditional: 這個成語也在提醒人們要重視理論和實踐的相結合。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge chéng yǔ yě zài tí xǐng rén men yào zhòng shì lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn de xiāng jié hé
sentences.english: .. used to describe people who only talk about grand theories but cannot solve practical problems.

sentences.simplified: 生活中，如果你遇到了像赵括这样的人，你可以这么说：
sentences.traditional: 生活中，如果你遇到了像趙括這樣的人，你可以這麼說：
sentences.pinyin: shēng huó zhōng rú guǒ nǐ yù dào le xiàng zhào kuò zhè yàng de rén nǐ kě yǐ zhè me shuō
sentences.english: This idiom also serves as a reminder for people to value the combination of theory and practice.

sentences.simplified: “虽然他提了很多建议，但经常只是纸上谈兵，没有真正实践过。”
sentences.traditional: “雖然他提了很多建議，但經常只是紙上談兵，沒有真正實踐過。”
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā tí le hěn duō jiàn yì dàn jīng cháng zhǐ shì zhǐ shàng tán bīng méi yǒu zhēn zhèng shí jiàn guò
sentences.english: In everyday life, if you encounter someone like Zhao Kuo, you can say:

sentences.simplified: 你也可以这样说：
sentences.traditional: 你也可以這樣說：
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yě kě yǐ zhè yàng shuō
sentences.english: “Although he has made many suggestions, they are often just ‘discussing military tactics on paper’ and never truly put into practice.”

sentences.simplified: “虽然他读了很多书，但是真正面对问题时，却发现自己只是纸上谈兵。”
sentences.traditional: “雖然他讀了很多書，但是真正面對問題時，卻發現自己只是紙上談兵。”
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā dú le hěn duō shū dàn shì zhēn zhèng miàn duì wèn tí shí què fā xiàn zì jǐ zhǐ shì zhǐ shàng tán bīng
sentences.english: You can also say:

sentence_translations: Discussing Military Tactics on Paper
During the Warring States period, China was divided into seven states, and there were constant wars among them for years on end.
In 260 BC, the Qin state and the Zhao state, two of the seven states, were engaged in a war.
After the first battle, the Zhao state was defeated.
The veteran general of the Zhao state, Lian Po, decided not to attack anymore.
He stationed his troops on the mountain, waiting for a favorable opportunity to launch a second battle.
Although the King of Zhao wanted to end the war as soon as possible, he still supported Lian Po’s approach, ..
.. because he knew that Lian Po was a very experienced veteran general.
However, after several months had passed, such sentiments began to emerge within the Zhao state:
Lian Po is just old and scared, so he doesn’t dare to fight.
The young General Zhao Kuo is very capable and more suitable to lead the army. Young people should be given the opportunity.
Who was Zhao Kuo? He was a young military officer from the Zhao state.
In the minds of the Zhao people, ..
.. Zhao Kuo had read many military books since childhood and also often discussed military strategies with his father.
He was considered to be an outstanding military talent.
However, unlike others, Zhao Kuo’s father never praised him and did not agree with Zhao Kuo participating in the war.
He said that Zhao Kuo had an overly simplistic understanding of war.
After hearing the opinions of other people many times, the King of Zhao was gradually swayed.
After some time, seeing that Lian Po was still stationed on the mountain with his troops without making any moves, ..
.. the King of Zhao decided to replace Lian Po with Zhao Kuo as the commanding general, leading the army to attack the Qin forces.
Zhao Kuo was very excited. After surveying the surroundings at the front line, he led his troops to launch an attack against the Qin army.
The battle progressed smoothly. Using the military strategies he had learned from books, Zhao Kuo continuously pushed back the Qin army.
He was extremely excited, chasing the retreating Qin army all the way, wanting to defeat them all.
Half a month later, Zhao Kuo’s army was running low on food, ..
.. and the convoy that was supposed to supply food from the homeland had not yet arrived.
It was only then that Zhao Kuo realized that in his pursuit of the Qin army, he had extended the front line too far.
The supply route had been blocked by another contingent of the Qin army.
Now his army was not only about to run out of food but also unable to return to the Zhao state.
The battlefield situation quickly changed.
The Qin army, which had been continuously retreating, counterattacked and surrounded the entire Zhao army.
At this point, Zhao Kuo realized that he had been deceived by the Qin army, but it was already too late.
The Zhao army was besieged for 46 days, and in the end, everyone, including Zhao Kuo, either starved to death or was killed.
Not a single one of the 450,000-strong army survived.
This is the story of Zhao Kuo’s “discussing military tactics on paper” in the Battle of Changping.
Although Zhao Kuo was well-versed in military books, ..
.. he focused solely on theoretical knowledge from the books and neglected practical experience.
As a result, he was unable to address the real issues that arose on the battlefield, leading to the great defeat of the Zhao state.
This great defeat also made future generations understand the importance of practical experience.
From then on, “discussing military tactics on paper” became an idiom ..
.. used to describe people who only talk about grand theories but cannot solve practical problems.
This idiom also serves as a reminder for people to value the combination of theory and practice.
In everyday life, if you encounter someone like Zhao Kuo, you can say:
“Although he has made many suggestions, they are often just ‘discussing military tactics on paper’ and never truly put into practice.”
You can also say:
“Although he has read many books, when faced with real problems, he finds that he is merely ‘discussing military tactics on paper’.”
